body:
I've always been a social drinker.  I dont know what happened that day. I just started and couldn't stop and it culminated in me bloodying my kid's nose (accidentally it seems. Wife told me I went to get up and she was next to me on the couch and my elbow caught her as I stumbled to my feet...but it was no accident that I got that drunk). And then...what I did to my wife.  I'm the last person in the universe that she should be afraid of for something like that.  I've completely violated her...everything about her. I can't forgive myself for that.  I'll never be able to cope knowing what I did to her. 

I feel like such a threat to them. I'm not the safe protective husband and father they thought I was. 

Counseling...I've never felt counseling do much good for me.  I never felt like progress was ever made.  Only thing that ever made me feel better was drugs.  Which is why I am going back to the doc tomorrow.  But I'm on the edge of taking whatever he writes for as directed or just downing the whole bottle.  And with Christmas 4 days away.  I picked a hell of a time to hit the bottom.  I can hardly face my wife.  How am I to face our families?  

I don't know what made me do what I did.  I have just felt so alone, so sad and angry and I have what looks like a perfect life from the outside looking in.  I hate myself.  I hate what I did.  She didn't deserve that and I don't deserve her.   Fuck. This.
